title: Introduce Session Synchronizer: unify session lifecycle, backoff presets, and parallel streaming ergonomics
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Added Session Synchronizer to centralize lease/heartbeat/prefetch and harmonized SDK backoff presets. Minor API ergonomics for streaming iterables across Python/TS/Go. Bumped SDK trio to v1.12.0.
description:
Motivation: Multiple SDKs implemented similar session/lease logic (heartbeats, prefetch, token refresh) that diverged subtly and caused intermittent live drift and flaky streaming reconnects under burst load. This PR introduces a lightweight Session Synchronizer library (tri-sdk surface + adapters) that centralizes: lease acquisition/renewal, coordinated heartbeat windows, prefetch hooks for streaming warmup, and a handful of opinionated retry/backoff presets. Goals were parity across SDKs, improved ergonomics for parallel stream consumers, and a safe version bump for downstream teams.

What changed (high level):
- Introduce core package: session_synchronizer (Python), @redwood/session-sync (TS), session/synchronizer (Go). Each adapter exposes a small set of primitives: StartLease(sessionOpts), Keepalive(ctx), PrefetchHints(payload), and AttachStream(streamHandle).
- Streaming ergonomics: new `ParallelStream` helper (all SDKs) which accepts a consumer concurrency hint and provides a safe async/pullstream wrapper that coordinates shared KV cache access and idempotent retry of in-flight chunks.
- Backoff and retry: consolidated presets (fast-warmup, steady-state, failfast) and mapped them to SDK retry builders. Default retry window shortened for short-lived ephemeral sessions to reduce stale token retries.
- Version bumps: Python SDK -> 1.12.0, TypeScript SDK -> 1.12.0, Go SDK -> v1.12.0 (changelogs updated).
- Docs & examples: added session-sync README, migration guide with code samples for Py/TS/Go, and a short recipe for migrating existing stream consumers to ParallelStream.

Commits (summary):
- 9a2e7f2: initial tri-sdk session synchronizer prototypes and API contracts
- 3c1b4ad: implement Python adapter + unit tests + docstrings
- f6b2d11: implement TS adapter, add async generator ParallelStream helper and examples
- b7d5a3c: implement Go adaptor, add integration test against local canary harness
- 0d4f9e2: consolidate retry presets and wire into SDK factories
- e12c34a: docs, changelogs, and release notes for tri-sdk bump

- sdk/python/tests/test_session_sync.py

Testing and CI:
- CI matrix: py3.10/3.11, node16/18, go1.20/1.21.
- Initial CI run: TypeScript build failed on lint (unused var in example) and Go vet flagged race in test harness. Those were fixed in subsequent commits.
- Final CI: all suites green, coverage unchanged (+0.3% on Python unit tests due to new tests).

Review conversation (high level):
- Ethan Wu: asked for clarity on who owns lease renewal backoff; requested adding telemetry hooks for lease failures (answered & added telemetry spans).
- Marisol Gutierrez: requested explicit invariants for ParallelStream (idempotency and ordering) and pointed out edge-case with negative concurrency; author added guardrails and a migration note.
- Tomás Novak: ran integration smoke against Dedicated canary; reported a transient reconnect gap — root cause was a 250ms jitter in the heartbeat window; adjusted heartbeat jitter bounds and added an e2e test that simulates burst reconnects.
- Author replies: addressed comments, pushed fixes, and left detailed notes in migration doc explaining behavioral changes and recommended knob settings for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Backward compatibility and migration notes:
- The public convenience helpers keep old surface intact; default factory behavior remains backward compatible. Some internal defaults (retry window for short-lived sessions) changed and may affect edge-case retry counts; migration guide lists the knobs to restore previous behavior.

Risk & rollout plan:
- Low risk: default behavior is backward compatible and feature is behind opt-in flags for older clients.
- Canary rollout: enabled on internal canary for two days, then staged to Dedicated pilot customers for validation.
- Monitoring: added two new alerts in Console for leaseRenewalFailureRate and parallelStreamRetrySpike.

Merge: Squash-and-merge after sign-off and green CI. Merged by Priya Raman on 2026-02-28.

ci_summary: Initial run: lint (TS) failed, go vet warned — fixed in follow-ups. Final run: all checks passed (unit, integration, linters). Coverage: +0.3% python tests.
notes: This PR intentionally centralizes session behavior; teams relying on custom heartbeat timings should read migration guide and opt-in to the new defaults before production rollout. Observability keys: leaseRenewalFailureRate, parallelStreamRetrySpike.
